description: This file defines a React component named PermissionsModal, which displays a modal dialog for user permissions authorization for a component interaction. It includes UI elements like buttons and links, and handles user actions to accept or deny permission requests.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Callback function invoked to approve the permission request, triggers the callback with true and dismisses the modal.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Callback function invoked to deny the permission request, triggers the callback with false and dismisses the modal.
